items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: So understanding that there was a song that Peggy Lee recorded, I don't know if you remember, it was “Is That All There Is?”

ctx.x: How did you know what strings were capable of? Was that from partly your high school education?

I had no idea. Didn’t have a clue. I mean I studied scores and I saw them. So now this is also interesting. Ariana Grande on the Tonight Show mentioned that – because I recorded her when she was twelve years old and wrote arrangements for her when she was seven with the Pops here in town. But she mentioned on the Tonight Show the first record I ever made with Bob Crewe. She found it and took the song and used it in one of her albums.
